$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for editors. Pawl ignores it.

extends.description: Policies to build on: a package name, a path relative to this file, or a list of them.

engine.description: The linter. `auto` is Biome, with ESLint next to it when the repo has a flat config.

formatter.description: The formatter. `auto` is Biome, unless the linter is not Biome and the repo has a Prettier config.

packs.description: Optional packs to switch on. `unicorn/recommended` starts a pack from the plugin preset.

strict.description: Use the stricter level of every rule that has one.

maxWarnings.description: Fail the check when there are more new warnings than this. A later layer can only lower it.

rules.description: Rule levels by ESLint's rule names. `biome:group/name` reaches a rule only Biome has.

options.description: Rule options in ESLint's shape, by the same names as `rules`. ESLint and Oxlint take them.

biomeOptions.description: Rule options in Biome's shape, by the same names as `rules`. Only Biome takes them.

overrides.description: Rule levels and options for some files only. Later entries win.

files.description: Glob patterns of the files. A pattern without a slash matches at any depth.

rules.description: Rule levels by ESLint's rule names. `biome:group/name` reaches a rule only Biome has.

options.description: Rule options in ESLint's shape, by the same names as `rules`. ESLint and Oxlint take them.

biomeOptions.description: Rule options in Biome's shape, by the same names as `rules`. Only Biome takes them.

locked.description: Rules that later layers may tighten but never loosen.

ignore.description: Extra glob patterns to skip. A pattern without a slash matches at any depth.

gitignore.description: Skip what the root .gitignore lists. On by default.

defaultIgnores.description: Skip build output, caches, lockfiles, AI tool folders and generated code. On by default.

runtime.description: Where the code runs, instead of what pawl detects.

detect.description: Work out the technologies from the dependencies and files. `false` turns it off.
